sentence: 지금 와인 셀러 온도를 체크하고 10분뒤에 다시 체크해서 1도 이상 차이가 나면, 스피커로 온도가 급변했다고 안내해줘.

args.Text: The wine cellar temperature has changed rapidly

ir_readable:
Execution plan

Start:
- Start now.

Behavior:
- Read TemperatureSensor.Temperature as the current temperature.
- Wait for 10 minutes.
- Read TemperatureSensor.Temperature as the current temperature.
- If abs(the current temperature - the current temperature) is at least 1, run Speaker.Speak(Text=The wine cellar temperature has changed rapidly).
- Otherwise, do nothing.
